name: new_sudoku_benchmark_2045_with_variants
description: A benchmark of Sudoku puzzles (including multiple variant rule-sets) designed to measure an AI system's ability to perform discrete combinatorial reasoning and constraint satisfaction. Tasks typically require producing a complete valid grid given a partial puzzle or variant-specific constraints. The benchmark evaluates both standard 9x9 puzzles and harder variants to probe logical inference, search, and stepwise problem solving.
reputation: Relatively new/specialized dataset with limited adoption outside puzzle/reasoning research communities.
